syncwarnings.banner.bad_feed: The server sent a list of changes that cannot be right. Nothing was changed on this device.
syncwarnings.banner.checkpoint_forged: The checkpoint on the server could not be verified with this vault's key, so it was ignored. Your items are not affected.
syncwarnings.banner.checkpoint_rolled_ba: The newest checkpoint on the server is older than one this device has already checked. The server may have been rolled back. Nothing was deleted on this device. Checkpoints are not uploaded until a check succeeds.
syncwarnings.banner.generic_stop: Sync is stopped for a reason this page has no text for. Nothing was deleted on this device, and nothing is fetched or sent until you choose.
syncwarnings.banner.restore_epoch_lowere: The server's restore number went down, which should never happen. Nothing was deleted on this device, and nothing is fetched or sent until you choose.
syncwarnings.banner.rollback_suspected: The server reports a position that is lower than this device has seen, which looks like a rollback. Nothing was deleted on this device, and nothing is fetched or sent until you choose.
syncwarnings.banner.server_hid_item: The server did not list an item it was holding. The item is kept on this device and nothing was deleted.
syncwarnings.banner.server_restored: The server was restored to an earlier state. Nothing was deleted on this device. Look at what happened before you choose.
syncwarnings.banner.server_shows_older_s: The server shows an older state than this device has seen. Nothing was deleted on this device. Checkpoints are not uploaded until a check succeeds.
syncwarnings.banner.sync_memory_full: This device's record of the server is full and cannot take more. Nothing was deleted. The only way on is to forget this server on this device and sign in again.
syncwarnings.banner.unsupported: This browser lacks a feature (Web Locks) that keeps several tabs from overwriting each other's record of the server. Nothing was deleted. Use a current browser.
syncwarnings.banner.verify_deferred: Checkpoint checks are paused. An item that the server hid was uploaded again from this device, so the server's checkpoint cannot be compared with it until the item has been changed past its old version. No checkpoints are uploaded meanwhile. Nothing was deleted.
syncwarnings.error.conflicts_many: {count} items have a conflict. Each is marked in the list; open it and choose which version to keep. Nothing was overwritten.
syncwarnings.error.restore_item_unreadab: An item could not be opened on this device, so nothing can be sent for it. It is kept as it is, and nothing was deleted.
syncwarnings.forget.cancelled: Nothing was changed. This device still remembers this server.
syncwarnings.forget.dialog_body: This device will forget this server and the account {email}: the saved items, the trash, the record of what the server showed before, and the secret key if this device remembers it. Nothing on the server is deleted. The next sign-in on this device counts as the first one, and you will need your secret key then.
syncwarnings.forget.dialog_body_pending: This device will forget this server and the account {email}: the saved items, the trash, the record of what the server showed before, and the secret key if this device remembers it. Nothing on the server is deleted. The next sign-in on this device counts as the first one, and you will need your secret key then. Changes not yet sent to the server, which will be lost: {count}.
syncwarnings.forget.dialog_body_shared: This device will forget this server and the account {email}: the record of what the server showed before, and the secret key if this device remembers it. The same account is also remembered under another address of this server, so the saved items, the trash and the sync flags are kept for that address. Nothing on the server is deleted. The next sign-in on this device counts as the first one, and you will need your secret key then.
syncwarnings.forget.dialog_body_shared_p: This device will forget this server and the account {email}: the record of what the server showed before, and the secret key if this device remembers it. The same account is also remembered under another address of this server, so the saved items, the trash and the sync flags are kept for that address. Nothing on the server is deleted. The next sign-in on this device counts as the first one, and you will need your secret key then. Changes not yet sent to the server, which stay saved for that address and are not lost: {count}.
syncwarnings.forget.dialog_title: Forget this server on this device?
syncwarnings.forget.done: This device has forgotten this server and this account. Nothing on the server was deleted. Sign in again to start from the server's data.
syncwarnings.forget.done_shared: This device has forgotten this server and this account. The same account is also remembered under another address of this server, so the saved items, the unsent changes, the trash and the sync flags were kept for that address. Forget it there as well to remove them. Nothing on the server was deleted.
syncwarnings.forget.error: This device could not forget the server. Nothing was removed from this device, but you may have been signed out. Try again.
syncwarnings.forget.heading: Forget this server
syncwarnings.forget.intro: Use this if you no longer trust this server, or if sync is stopped and you want to start over from the server's data. Only this device is changed.
syncwarnings.forget.link: Forget this server on this device
syncwarnings.forget.not_found: This device holds nothing for that address on this server.
syncwarnings.forget.title: Forget this server
syncwarnings.note.checked_still: Checked again. The warning still stands.
syncwarnings.note.failed: That did not work. Nothing was changed on this device.
syncwarnings.note.not_checked: The server could not be reached. Nothing was changed. Try again later.
syncwarnings.note.resume_still: The cause is still there, so sync stays stopped.
syncwarnings.restored.busy: Sync is busy accepting an older state. Wait a moment, then try again.
syncwarnings.restored.conflicts_note: Every item that already exists on the server comes back as a conflict. You choose which version to keep, and nothing is overwritten without your choice.
syncwarnings.restored.done: Done. This device follows the server again. Your newer changes sent to the server: {reuploaded}. Items with a conflict for you to decide: {conflicts}.
syncwarnings.restored.done_conflicts: {count} items need your decision. Each is marked as a conflict in the list; open it to see both versions and choose which to keep. Nothing was overwritten.
syncwarnings.restored.failed: The older state could not be accepted. Sync stays stopped and nothing was deleted. Try again, or forget this server.
syncwarnings.restored.heading: The server was restored
syncwarnings.restored.intro_choice: If you accept, this device follows the server again from its older state. Changes you made here that the server does not have are sent to the server. If the server changed an item after it was restored, that item becomes a conflict and you choose which version to keep. Nothing is overwritten without your choice.
syncwarnings.restored.intro_safe: The server now shows an older state than this device has seen before. This usually happens when the server is restored from a backup. Nothing on this device was deleted, and sync is stopped until you decide.
syncwarnings.restored.intro_warn: Accept only if you know the server was restored. Accepting makes the older state this device's new starting point, and other devices will show the same notice. If you did not expect this, leave sync stopped or forget this server.
syncwarnings.restored.invalid_state: This page is out of date: the older state may already have been accepted, for example in another tab. Nothing was deleted. Reload the page, or let sync try again.
syncwarnings.restored.manifest_older: The server's account settings are older too. The unlock methods (password, recovery key, passkeys) may have reverted to an earlier state. Check them after you accept.
syncwarnings.restored.not_applicable: There is nothing to decide here. Sync is not stopped because of a restored server.
syncwarnings.restored.not_verified: The server's older state does not check out against what this device has verified, so it was not accepted. Nothing was changed or deleted. Leave sync stopped, or forget this server. Trying again will not help unless the server changes.
syncwarnings.restored.not_verified_no_ch: The server holds no checkpoint to compare the older state with.
syncwarnings.restored.preview_failed: The server's older state could not be read, so the effect cannot be shown yet. Nothing was changed.
syncwarnings.restored.preview_reupload: Your newer changes that will be sent to the server: {count}
syncwarnings.restored.resume_still: Sync is still stopped. The cause is still there.
syncwarnings.restored.stopped: The vault was locked. Unlock it and open this page again. Nothing was changed.
syncwarnings.restored.title: The server was restored
syncwarnings.restored.unreadable: Items that could not be opened on this device and were not sent: {count}. They are kept as they are.
syncwarnings.restored.word_wrong: That is not the word. Nothing was changed.
